decisions.reason: Its prominent launch as a new product line and close integration with the established offer create strong sunk costs and public commitment, making early withdrawal very unlikely.
Although less visible, the education institute builds on existing capabilities and represents committed resources, so the firm is inclined to persist rather than drop it after one year.
The support tool has lower public visibility but still embodies development investment and fits the firm's support offer, so management is likely to keep it despite any modest early disappointment.
